_meta.purpose: Allied-standards graph: which standards a given standard depends on, and why.
_meta.method: Read from the referred-standards annexes and materials clauses of the standards themselves, via publicly hosted copies (law.resource.org, archive.org). Relationships are recorded only where the source standard actually cites the target.
_meta.coverage_warning: Only standards present in this corpus can be linked. A standard with no relationships here has not been researched, which is not the same as having none. Targets marked outside_corpus are real citations to standards the pilot corpus does not contain -- they are shown so the cluster is not silently truncated, but they cannot be opened.

relation_types.normative_reference: The source standard requires conformance to the target. Citing the source without the target leaves a specification incomplete.
relation_types.test_method: The target defines how to test conformance to the source.
relation_types.material_spec: The target specifies a material the source is built from.
relation_types.terminology: The target defines terms the source uses.
relation_types.installation: The target governs how the product is installed or used.
relation_types.related_product: A sibling or alternative product standard in the same family.
